title: beFree
description: Money in and out per budgeting cycle, budgets and goals, how entries arrive (app chat, WhatsApp, form) and the pods behind it.

panels.title: Cycle
panels.description: The budgeting month in progress. It starts on your configured start day, so it does not follow the calendar month.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
cfg AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT month_start_day FROM app_settings LIMIT 1), 1) AS dflt),
today AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date AS t),
labels AS (
  -- The label of the cycle containing today: the month whose start is the latest one <= today.
  SELECT (date_trunc('month', t) + make_interval(months => k))::date AS label
  FROM today, generate_series(-2, 1) k
),
starts AS (
  SELECT l.label,
         CASE WHEN sd.d = 1 THEN l.label
              ELSE (l.label - interval '1 month')::date + (least(sd.d, 28) - 1) END AS start
  FROM labels l
  CROSS JOIN cfg
  LEFT JOIN month_starts ms ON ms.period = l.label
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce(ms.start_day, cfg.dflt) AS d) sd
),
spans AS (
  SELECT label, start, lead(start) OVER (ORDER BY label) AS stop FROM starts
),
cyc AS (
  SELECT label, start, stop FROM spans, today
  WHERE stop IS NOT NULL AND start <= t ORDER BY label DESC LIMIT 1
),
cur AS (SELECT * FROM cyc ORDER BY label DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT to_char(label, 'Mon YYYY') || '  ·  ' || to_char(start, 'DD Mon') || ' – ' || to_char(stop - 1, 'DD Mon') AS value FROM cur

panels.description: This cycle's budgets against what was spent in each category.

WITH

today AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date AS t),
labels AS (
  -- The label of the cycle containing today: the month whose start is the latest one <= today.

  FROM today, generate_series(-2, 1) k
),
starts AS (
  SELECT l.label,
         CASE WHEN sd.d = 1 THEN l.label
              ELSE (l.label - interval '1 month')::date + (least(sd.d, 28) - 1) END AS start
  FROM labels l
  CROSS JOIN cfg
  LEFT JOIN month_starts ms ON ms.period = l.label
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce(ms.start_day, cfg.dflt) AS d) sd
),

      WHERE t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.goal_id IS NULL AND t.occurredon >= cur.start AND t.occurredon < cur.stop GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.name AS "Category", b.limit_amount AS "Budget", coalesce(s.spent, 0) AS "Spent",
       b.limit_amount - coalesce(s.spent, 0) AS "Left", coalesce(s.spent, 0) / nullif(b.limit_amount, 0) AS "Used"
FROM budgets b JOIN cur ON b.period = cur.label JOIN categories c ON c.id = b.category_id
LEFT JOIN s ON s.category_id = b.category_id ORDER BY 5 DESC

panels.title: This cycle vs the last one
panels.description: Cumulative spend by day of the cycle. The last cycle is shifted onto this one's dates so the two lines compare day for day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
cfg AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT month_start_day FROM app_settings LIMIT 1), 1) AS dflt),
today AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date AS t),
labels AS (
  -- The label of the cycle containing today: the month whose start is the latest one <= today.
  SELECT (date_trunc('month', t) + make_interval(months => k))::date AS label
  FROM today, generate_series(-3, 1) k
),
starts AS (
  SELECT l.label,
         CASE WHEN sd.d = 1 THEN l.label
              ELSE (l.label - interval '1 month')::date + (least(sd.d, 28) - 1) END AS start
  FROM labels l
  CROSS JOIN cfg
  LEFT JOIN month_starts ms ON ms.period = l.label
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce(ms.start_day, cfg.dflt) AS d) sd
),
spans AS (
  SELECT label, start, lead(start) OVER (ORDER BY label) AS stop FROM starts
),
cyc AS (
  SELECT label, start, stop FROM spans, today
  WHERE stop IS NOT NULL AND start <= t ORDER BY label DESC LIMIT 2
),
cur AS (SELECT * FROM cyc ORDER BY label DESC LIMIT 1),
ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY label DESC) AS k FROM cyc),
days AS (
  SELECT r.k, g::date AS day, (g::date - r.start) AS offs FROM ranked r,
         generate_series(r.start, least(r.stop - 1, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date), interval '1 day') g
),
daily AS (
  SELECT days.k, days.offs, coalesce(sum(t.amount), 0) AS amt
  FROM days LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.occurredon = days.day AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.goal_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ((SELECT start FROM ranked WHERE k = 1) + offs)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon' AS time,
       CASE WHEN k = 1 THEN 'This cycle' ELSE 'Last cycle' END AS metric,
       sum(amt) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY offs) AS value
FROM daily ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Income and expenses per cycle
panels.description: The last 12 cycles that have any entries.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
cfg AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT month_start_day FROM app_settings LIMIT 1), 1) AS dflt),
today AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date AS t),
labels AS (
  -- The label of the cycle containing today: the month whose start is the latest one <= today.
  SELECT (date_trunc('month', t) + make_interval(months => k))::date AS label
  FROM today, generate_series(-13, 1) k
),
starts AS (
  SELECT l.label,
         CASE WHEN sd.d = 1 THEN l.label
              ELSE (l.label - interval '1 month')::date + (least(sd.d, 28) - 1) END AS start
  FROM labels l
  CROSS JOIN cfg
  LEFT JOIN month_starts ms ON ms.period = l.label
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce(ms.start_day, cfg.dflt) AS d) sd
),
spans AS (
  SELECT label, start, lead(start) OVER (ORDER BY label) AS stop FROM starts
),
cyc AS (
  SELECT label, start, stop FROM spans, today
  WHERE stop IS NOT NULL AND start <= t ORDER BY label DESC LIMIT 12
),
cur AS (SELECT * FROM cyc ORDER BY label DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT to_char(cyc.label, 'Mon YY') AS cycle,
       coalesce(sum(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'INCOME'), 0) AS "Income",
       coalesce(sum(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.goal_id IS NULL), 0) AS "Expenses"
FROM cyc LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.occurredon >= cyc.start AND t.occurredon < cyc.stop
GROUP BY cyc.label HAVING count(t.id) > 0 ORDER BY cyc.label

panels.title: Savings goals
panels.description: Saved = opening amount + contributions − expenses paid from the goal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT g.name AS "Goal", g.target AS "Target",
       g.initial_amount + coalesce((SELECT sum(amount) FROM goal_contributions gc WHERE gc.goal_id = g.id), 0)
         - coalesce((SELECT sum(amount) FROM transactions t WHERE t.goal_id = g.id), 0) AS "Saved",
       (g.initial_amount + coalesce((SELECT sum(amount) FROM goal_contributions gc WHERE gc.goal_id = g.id), 0)
         - coalesce((SELECT sum(amount) FROM transactions t WHERE t.goal_id = g.id), 0)) / nullif(g.target, 0) AS "Progress",
       g.target_date AS "By", g.achieved_on AS "Achieved"
FROM goals g ORDER BY g.achieved_on NULLS FIRST, 4 DESC

panels.title: Latest entries
panels.description: The last 15 entries recorded, newest first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.occurredon AS "Date", t.description AS "Description", coalesce(c.name, '—') AS "Category",
       CASE WHEN t.type = 'INCOME' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END AS "Amount",
       CASE WHEN t.external_id LIKE 'app-%' THEN 'app chat' WHEN t.external_id LIKE 'wamid%' THEN 'WhatsApp'
            WHEN t.external_id IS NULL THEN 'form' ELSE lower(t.source) END AS "Via",
       t.createdat AS "Added"
FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
ORDER BY t.createdat DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Entries recorded, by channel
panels.description: Transactions created per day by where they came from: the assistant in the app's chat, a WhatsApp message, or the manual form.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.createdat, '1d'),
       CASE WHEN t.external_id LIKE 'app-%' THEN 'app chat' WHEN t.external_id LIKE 'wamid%' THEN 'WhatsApp'
            WHEN t.external_id IS NULL THEN 'form' ELSE lower(t.source) END AS metric,
       count(*) AS value
FROM transactions t WHERE $__timeFilter(t.createdat) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: WhatsApp messages received
panels.description: Messages accepted from the WhatsApp webhook per day, and whether they produced a transaction. 'No entry' is a question or command, or a failure (see the logs below).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.received_at, '1d'),
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions t WHERE split_part(t.external_id, '#', 1) = m.external_id)) AS "Recorded something",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions t WHERE split_part(t.external_id, '#', 1) = m.external_id)) AS "No entry"
FROM inbound_messages m WHERE $__timeFilter(m.received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Assistant actions
panels.description: Tools the AI assistant called (record a transaction, check a budget, add to a goal...), from the backend log. One message can trigger several.

panels.title: API calls by endpoint
panels.description: Requests per endpoint from the nginx access log (ids and query strings dropped). POST /api/chat is the in-app assistant; /webhooks/whatsapp is Meta delivering messages.

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({namespace="befree", container="nginx"} |~ "\"(GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE) /(api|webhooks)/" | regexp `"(?P<method>[A-Z]+) /(?P<path>(api|webhooks)/[a-z]+)` | label_format endpoint=`{{.method}} /{{.path}}` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Assistant and WhatsApp failures
panels.description: Things that went wrong turning a message into entries: the LLM call, media (photo, audio, PDF), the reply, or a webhook with a bad signature.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({namespace="befree", container="backend"} |~ "Assistant failed|Failed to handle WhatsApp|Unhandled failure processing|recordTransaction failed|Could not (read|transcribe|download)|Failed to send WhatsApp|Rejected WhatsApp webhook" | regexp `(?P<kind>Assistant failed|Failed to handle WhatsApp|Unhandled failure processing|recordTransaction failed|Could not (read|transcribe|download)|Failed to send WhatsApp|Rejected WhatsApp webhook)` [$__auto]))
